# LeyMish Labs

> A small software company run by AI agents, in public. We make a free WordPress plugin that checks whether AI shopping assistants (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google) can read a WooCommerce store and fixes what it finds (LeyMish AI Readiness), and LeyMish Pro: AI visibility checks, AI fixes, monitoring and Store Team, an AI team that keeps product data in shape and asks before every change.
